==Equipment and apparel==
Del Potro used the [[Wilson Sporting Goods|Wilson]] Hyper ProStaff 6.1 Midplus Stretch early on in his career, and has continued to use this racquet under new paint jobs years later. Del Potro is very superstitious, and after suffering a wrist injury shortly after switching to the [[Wilson Sporting Goods|Wilson]] BLX Pro Tour paint job in 2010, he returned to playing with the then outdated [[Wilson Sporting Goods|Wilson]] K-Factor 6.1 95 paint job.<ref>{{cite web |title=Del Potro Returns to Sydney and Changes Racquet |url=http://www.tennisnow.com/News/Del-Potro-Returns-to-Sydney-and-Changes-Racquet.aspx |publisher=Tennis Now |access-date=22 September 2014 |archive-date=5 October 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141005215109/http://www.tennisnow.com/News/Del-Potro-Returns-to-Sydney-and-Changes-Racquet.aspx |url-status=live}}</ref> He particularly favored the exact racquets he had used to win his only Grand Slam title at the 2009 [[US Open (tennis)|US Open]]. He again refused to update his racquet to the [[Wilson Sporting Goods|Wilson]] BLX Juice Pro in 2012, and in 2014 had only a few K-Factor racquets left.<ref>{{cite news |title=Del Potro may run out of old racquets |url=https://www.theaustralian.com.au/sport/tennis/del-potro-may-run-out-of-old-racquets/news-story/4a7f91ae0439867870136f05f2f4b568 |newspaper=The Australian |url-access=subscription |access-date=22 September 2014}}</ref> He makes use of the same racket painted to resemble the Wilson ProStaff 97. For strings, he uses Luxilon ALU Power strung at 58 lbs.<ref>{{cite web |title=Del Potro's racquet |url=https://tennisnerd.net/gear/racquets/pro-player-racquets/del-potros-racquet/5969 |website=tennisnerd |date=2 April 2020}}</ref>

His clothing sponsor was [[Nike, Inc.|Nike]]. He used to wear sleeveless shirts, but later on has worn crew shirts, and often also sports double-wide [[wristbands]] and a [[Kerchief|bandana]]. For shoes, he wears Nike Air Max Cages.<ref name="ATP Profile"/>

==Record against the Big Four==
Del Potro has a combined {{tennis record|won=20|lost=51|small=yes}} record against all members of the [[Big Four (tennis)|Big Four]], which is one of the best in this category. He is also one of the few to have won at least three matches against each of the four.

===Roger Federer===
Del Potro has a {{tennis record|won=7|lost=18|small=yes}} record against [[Roger Federer]], and a {{tennis record|won=4|lost=2|small=yes}} record in finals.<ref name="h2h federer">{{cite web |title=Juan Martin del Potro vs Roger Federer |url=https://www.atptour.com/en/players/atp-head-2-head/juan-martin-del-potro-vs-roger-federer/d683/f324 |website=ATP Tour |publisher=Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP)}}</ref> Besides the [[2009 US Open – Men's singles|2009 US Open]] title, del Potro also captured the [[Swiss Indoors#Singles|2012 and 2013 Swiss Indoors]] finals and the [[2018 BNP Paribas Open – Men's singles|2018 Indian Wells]] final, while Federer won the [[2012 ABN AMRO World Tennis Tournament – Singles|2012 Rotterdam Open]] and the [[2017 Swiss Indoors – Singles|2017 Basel Open]]. Federer won their five-set meeting at the [[2009 French Open – Men's singles|2009 French Open]] semifinals, and the longest best-of-three-set match in history at the [[Tennis at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Men's singles|2012 Olympic]] semifinal, 19–17 in the deciding set. Del Potro prevailed in the [[2017 US Open – Men's singles|2017 US Open]] quarterfinals against Federer in four sets.<ref name="h2h federer"/>

===Novak Djokovic===
Del Potro has a {{tennis record|won=4|lost=16|small=yes}} record against [[Novak Djokovic]].<ref name="h2h djokovic">{{cite web |title=Juan Martin del Potro vs Novak Djokovic |url=https://www.atptour.com/en/players/atp-head-2-head/juan-martin%20del%20potro-vs-novak-djokovic/D683/D643 |website=ATP Tour |publisher=Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP)}}</ref> Djokovic won their first four meetings, before back to back victories for del Potro at the 2011 Davis Cup and their bronze medal match at the [[Tennis at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Men's singles|2012 Summer Olympics]] in straight sets. In [[2013 ATP World Tour|2013]] Djokovic won an epic five-setter at the [[2013 Wimbledon Championships – Men's singles|2013 Wimbledon Championships]] semifinals and a three-setter at the [[2013 Shanghai Rolex Masters – Singles|2013 Shanghai Masters]] final, while del Potro defeated Djokovic en route to his second [[ATP World Tour Masters 1000|Masters 1000]] final, at the [[2013 BNP Paribas Open – Men's singles|2013 Indian Wells Masters]]. Del Potro upset Djokovic in the first round at the [[Tennis at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's singles|2016 Rio Olympics]] en route to the silver medal. Djokovic defeated Del Potro in three close sets in the final of the [[2018 US Open – Men's singles|2018 US Open]], which was the first grand slam final for Del Potro since his victory at the [[2009 US Open (tennis)|2009 US Open]]. Three of his four victories have come via national representation tournaments.<ref name="h2h djokovic"/>

===Rafael Nadal===
Del Potro has a {{tennis record|won=6|lost=11|small=yes}} record against [[Rafael Nadal]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Juan Martin del Potro vs Rafael Nadal |url=https://www.atptour.com/en/players/atp-head-2-head/juan-martin%20del%20potro-vs-rafael-nadal/D683/N409 |website=ATP Tour |publisher=Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP)}}</ref> He bested Nadal in the semifinals en route to his [[2009 US Open – Men's singles|2009 US Open]] title, which was the first time a player managed to beat both Roger Federer and Nadal in the same Grand Slam tournament (Novak Djokovic subsequently did the same at the 2011 US Open). However, the Spaniard managed to win both times in the [[Indian Wells Masters]] encounters, in the [[2011 BNP Paribas Open – Men's singles|2011]] semifinal and the [[2013 BNP Paribas Open – Men's singles|2013]] final. Nadal also won the fourth and last rubber of the [[2011 Davis Cup World Group#Spain vs. Argentina|2011 Davis Cup]] final against the Argentine. Del Potro gained the upper hand at the [[2013 Shanghai Rolex Masters – Singles|2013 Shanghai Masters]], defeating Nadal to reach the final where he lost to Djokovic. Del Potro defeated Nadal in a third set tiebreak in the semifinal of the [[Tennis at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's singles|2016 Olympics]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]],<ref>{{cite news |last=Streeter |first=Kurt |title=Juan Martin del Potro's dream run in Rio nearing gold |url=https://www.espn.com/olympics/summer/tennis/story/_/id/17294431/2016-olympics-juan-martin-del-potro-dream-run-rio-nearing-gold |url-status=live |publisher=ESPN |date=14 August 2016 |access-date=15 August 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160815024515/http://www.espn.com/olympics/summer/tennis/story/_/id/17294431/2016-olympics-juan-martin-del-potro-dream-run-rio-nearing-gold |archive-date=15 August 2016}}</ref> while Nadal stopped Del Potro's 2017 US Open run, defeating him in a four-set semifinal. In the quarterfinals of [[2018 Wimbledon Championships – Men's singles|2018 Wimbledon]], Nadal came from two sets to one down to defeat Del Potro in an epic five-set match. In their last meeting, Del Potro advanced to the final of the [[2018 US Open – Men's singles|2018 US Open]] when Nadal had to retire, while trailing by two sets to love.<ref name="2018_usopen_nadal"/>

===Andy Murray===
Del Potro has a {{tennis record|won=3|lost=7|small=yes}} record against [[Andy Murray]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Juan Martin del Potro vs Andy Murray |url=https://www.atptour.com/en/players/atp-head-2-head/juan-martin%20del%20potro-vs-andy-murray/D683/MC10 |website=ATP Tour |publisher=Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP)}}</ref> They only played two finals. The first was in the [[2009 Rogers Masters – Singles|2009 Rogers Cup]], which was won by Murray. However, when del Potro beat Murray in the quarterfinals of the [[2013 BNP Paribas Open – Men's singles|2013 BNP Paribas Open]], del Potro won against all members of the Big Four in 2013. In their second final, del Potro lost to Murray in the [[Tennis at the 2016 Summer Olympics|2016 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="2016 olympics">{{cite news |last=Baxter |first=Kevin |title=Andy Murray repeats as men's singles champion with four-set victory over Juan Martin del Potro |url=http://www.latimes.com/sports/olympics/la-sp-oly-rio-2016-murray-seeks-second-straight-olympic-1471204454-htmlstory.html |url-status=live |work=Los Angeles Times |date=14 August 2016 |access-date=15 August 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160815212653/http://www.latimes.com/sports/olympics/la-sp-oly-rio-2016-murray-seeks-second-straight-olympic-1471204454-htmlstory.html |archive-date=15 August 2016}}</ref> However, during Argentina's Davis Cup semi-final tie against Great Britain, del Potro got revenge by beating Andy Murray in a five-set thriller that was, for each man, the longest match of his career.

==Personal life==
Del Potro dated singer [[Jimena Barón]] from April 2017 until February 2018.<ref>{{cite web |title=Del Potro split with his girlfriend: 'I didn't have the best preparation' |url=https://www.tennisworldusa.org/tennis/news/Tennis_Interviews/52165/del-potro-split-with-his-girlfriend-i-didn-t-have-the-best-preparation-/ |access-date=3 April 2021 |website=Tennis World USA |date=21 February 2018 |archive-date=31 May 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180531091252/http://www.tennisworldusa.org/tennis/news/Tennis_Interviews/52165/del-potro-split-with-his-girlfriend-i-didn-t-have-the-best-preparation-/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Del Potro dated model Sofia Jimenez from December 2018<ref>{{cite web |title=Juan Martin Del Potro's love story came to an end |url=https://www.tennisworldusa.org/tennis/news/Tennis_Stories/87864/juan-martin-del-potro-s-love-story-came-to-an-end/ |access-date=3 April 2021 |website=Tennis World USA |date=20 May 2020 |archive-date=27 August 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200827093726/https://www.tennisworldusa.org/tennis/news/Tennis_Stories/87864/juan-martin-del-potro-s-love-story-came-to-an-end/ |url-status=live}}</ref> until their breakup in May 2020.<ref>{{cite web |title=El sentido mensaje de Sofía "Jujuy" Jiménez por su separación de Juan Martín del Potro |url=https://www.infobae.com/teleshow/infoshow/2020/05/12/el-reflexivo-mensaje-de-sofia-jujuy-jimenez-luego-de-confirmar-su-separacion-de-juan-martin-del-potro/ |date=12 May 2020 |access-date=3 April 2021 |website=infobae |language=es-ES |archive-date=9 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200609045019/https://www.infobae.com/teleshow/infoshow/2020/05/12/el-reflexivo-mensaje-de-sofia-jujuy-jimenez-luego-de-confirmar-su-separacion-de-juan-martin-del-potro/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2022, it was revealed that Daniel del Potro (Juan Martín's late father) had misappropriated US$30 million of his son's career earnings while managing his financial affairs.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.cronica.com.ar/sociedad/Del-Potro-quedo-en-la-ruina-por-culpa-de-su-padre-quien-lo-estafo-por-30-millones-de-dolares-20220113-0173.html |title=Del Potro quedó en la ruina por culpa de su padre, quien lo estafó por 30 millones de dólares |access-date=14 January 2022 |archive-date=14 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220114020602/https://www.cronica.com.ar/sociedad/Del-Potro-quedo-en-la-ruina-por-culpa-de-su-padre-quien-lo-estafo-por-30-millones-de-dolares-20220113-0173.html?utm_source=dlvr.it&utm_medium=twitter |url-status=live}}</ref> A documentary on Juan Martín was directed by [[Rodolfo Lamboglia]] and released in 2023.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://espndeportes.espn.com/tenis/nota/_/id/11568032/star-channel-presenta-del-potro-el-ultimo-match-point |title=Star Channel presenta "Del Potro: El último match point" |date=3 February 2023}}</ref>

In May 2013 del Potro met [[Pope Francis]], a fellow Argentine, after [[Mass in the Catholic Church|Mass]] at the [[Vatican City|Vatican]] in Rome and described it as an incredible experience which he would never forget.<ref>{{cite magazine |title=Juan Martin del Potro meets new pope |url=https://www.si.com/tennis/2013/05/16/juan-martin-del-potro-pope |magazine=Sports Illustrated |date=16 May 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |author1=Jonathan Scott |title=Del Potro greets Pope, gives him tennis racquet |url=https://www.tennis.com/news/articles/del-potro-greets-pope-gives-him-tennis-racquet |website=Tennis.com |date=16 May 2013}}</ref> He is [[Catholic Church|Catholic]].<ref name="independent.co.uk"/>
